en: The front image shows a historical black-and-white scene of a public celebration or parade with people—some in uniform—gathered in a town square. There are decorated buildings with German shop names such as 'August För Borde' and 'Gottlieb Burgdorf Nähmaschinen Geschäft'. There are flags, garlands, and several men on horseback in formal parade attire. The crowd includes well-dressed adults and children. The postcard's back includes handwritten German script.
